skills.reference_body: Define intended use, model rights, units, dimensions, tolerances, wall thickness, clearances, watertightness, normals, manifold geometry, resolution, orientation assumptions, assembly, printer constraints, and acceptance tests. Repair only with traceable changes, preserve the editable source, and validate the exported mesh with representative slicing, dimensional checks, fit, and functional prototypes before production.
skills.asset_body:
# STL Production Plan

## Intended use, rights, units, dimensions, tolerance, owner, and target process

| Geometry check | Requirement | Observed | Correction | Validation | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Walls, clearances, manifold state, normals, resolution, assembly, and orientation

## Slice preview, dimensional, fit, function, repair, and regression tests

## Source file, export version, approval, limitations, and archive
skills.recovery: If units, dimensions, rights, source geometry, printer constraints, or acceptance evidence is unresolved, keep the STL in draft. Do not release it for safety-critical or irreversible production until representative slicing and fit tests pass.
skills.recovery_scenario: STL geometry or acceptance evidence is incomplete.

skills.reference_body: Build profiles from a known printer, firmware, nozzle, build surface, material brand and batch, drying state, environment, model needs, and manufacturer limits. Control temperatures, flow, speed, acceleration, cooling, layer height, line width, walls, infill, supports, adhesion, retraction, seams, and safety. Calibrate in dependency order, change one variable at a time, and version validated profiles with rollback.
skills.asset_body:

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Temperature, flow, speed, cooling, geometry, retraction, supports, and adhesion

## Calibration order, test models, acceptance, repeatability, and regression

## Validated profile, version, compatibility, rollback, and review date
skills.recovery: If machine state, manufacturer limits, material condition, calibration evidence, or acceptance criteria is unresolved, preserve the last validated profile. Do not compensate for mechanical faults with unsafe temperatures or uncontrolled parameter changes.
skills.recovery_scenario: Slicer baseline or calibration evidence is incomplete.

skills.reference_body: Preserve the failed part, job file, model, profile, printer state, material batch, drying history, environment, maintenance, logs, photos, and failure timing. Classify geometry, slicing, adhesion, extrusion, motion, temperature, cooling, material, support, environment, or hardware causes. Test the lowest-risk hypotheses in dependency order, change one variable at a time, and never bypass guards or continue damaging trials.
skills.asset_body:
# Print Failure Diagnosis

## Failure, model, printer, profile, material batch, environment, and evidence

| Hypothesis | Supporting evidence | Safe test | Result | Disposition | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Failure timing, geometry, slicing, adhesion, extrusion, motion, heat, and cooling

## Containment, maintenance, controlled trials, regression, and repeatability

## Root cause, correction, validated profile, prevention, and closure
skills.recovery: If the machine has unsafe motion, overheating, electrical, ventilation, damaged hardware, or unknown-material indicators, stop and remove it from service. Preserve evidence and escalate to qualified maintenance rather than continuing diagnostic prints.
skills.recovery_scenario: Print failure may involve unsafe equipment.

skills.reference_body: Optimize only after verifying material identity, usable sheet dimensions, grain or surface direction, defects, keep-out zones, fixture, kerf, process order, heat accumulation, ventilation, fire controls, artwork rights, part orientation, spacing, tabs, labels, and removal sequence. Prioritize safety, quality, and traceability before material yield. Validate with a low-risk preview and representative coupon.
